invented_facts: The monthly cloud bill often grows beyond expectations, and many firms pay for both cloud resources and powerful local hardware without a clear view of fleet cost.
Aurora reduces device count and service complexity.
A 15-minute conversation is proposed; that duration is not in the attachments.
Aurora can run models up to 30 billion parameters locally without stating the required configuration of at least 64 GB of memory.
Approving Aurora now means it can be received when the budget opens.
Client data stays under the firm's control as an unqualified guarantee.
notes: All three emails have subjects and follow the requested sequence, but email 1 has two calls to action and exceeds 120 words when its greeting and sign-off are counted. The unsupported claims and missing memory qualification would need correction before sending.
